title: Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS) Production
description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS. THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE IS PUBLISHED FOR MARKET RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. THE GOVERNMENT IS NOT SEEKING OR ACCEPTING UNSOLICITED PROPOSALS. This notice is a Request for Information (RFI) as defined in FAR 15.101(c). The Portfolio Acquisition Executive Mission Systems (PAE MS) is conducting market research for the Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS). ACNS helps to determine vessel position based on optical sighting of celestial objects including stars and resident space objects (RSOs) such as satellites and space debris. Ship�s position derived from ACNS shall be used to improve the resilience of the surface ship Positioning, Navigation, and Timing (PNT) system of systems suite by providing an Alternative Position Source (APS) to support Assured PNT. U.S. Navy and commercial enterprises leverage a variety of navigation solutions that allow vessels to safely navigate with and without GPS. The U.S. Navy is looking to modernize legacy systems over time. This RFI seeks information on prospective technologies that could be leveraged or developed as enablers for an ACNS solution. This RFI seeks to understand how interested parties would integrate the ACNS with navigation sensors and other ship equipment specifically Global Positioning System-Based Positioning, Navigation, and Timing Service (GPNTS). PAE MS invites all interested potential sources, including small business concerns, to submit written information sufficient to demonstrate the respondent�s ability to fulfill the requirements. For those interested parties that have technologies which may not achieve a Technology Readiness Level (TRL) of 8-9 by FY 2029, please provide information on current research and development efforts that may address some or all requirements of this RFI beyond FY 2029. Responses are requested by 27 November 2026. Questions or clarifications related to this RFI may be submitted electronically to Ms. Liz Bonilla-Sotomayor at liz.c.bonilla-sotomayor.civ@us.navy.mil and Ms. Andrea Longo at andrea.t.longo.civ@us.navy.mil. Verbal questions will not be accepted. Questions shall not contain classified information. Please ensure that the subject line of any emails containing responses or questions related to this notice includes the name of your firm and �Automated Celestial Navigation System (ACNS) RFI Response� (without quotation marks) in the subject line. Responses are limited to a maximum of fifteen (15) pages in length, excluding the cover page, within a minimum font size of 10 points. Generic capability statements that do not address the information requested in this RFI will be deemed non-responsive without any further communication from the Government. All responsive submissions received by the due date noted in this RFI may be considered by the Government to inform the resulting Request for Proposal. All information received bearing proprietary markings will be handled in accordance with applicable statutes and regulations. Responses to this notice will not be returned and will be maintained or destroyed in accordance with the Government�s records management policy. An acknowledgement of receipt will be provided for all responses received. If you do not receive an acknowledgement within two working days, please notify the points of contact listed in this notice. All materials submitted in response to this RFI should be UNCLASSIFIED. Responses to this notice must include the following: Include a cover page containing the following information: Sources Sought number for this notice (N00024-27-IWS-6-0002) Company Name Mailing address and physical address (if different) DUNS number CAGE code Business size status (based on NAICS code 334511) Type of small business (if applicable) Facility Security Clearance (FSC) level Name, position, email address, and phone number of point(s) of contact Interested parties submitting proposed solutions shall include the following in the RFI submission: Provide System Characteristics: Average position fix accuracy of the proposed system; Operational capabilities across day, twilight, and nighttime conditions; Ephemeris data age for fix accuracy; How quality of each position fix is indicated; Ability of the system to accept data formats sourced from the United States Naval Observatory (USNO); Type of Earth Orientation Parameter (EOP) data format; Average position fix frequency rate (for Stars-Only and Stars-Satellites). Provide Component Characteristics: 1) What is the current configuration of the proposed system? 2) Sensor volume and physical dimensions; 3) Sensor weight; 4) What environmental Military Standards does your proposed system meet (i.e. MIL-STD-810H CH1 (Environmental Engineering Considerations and Laboratory Tests), MIL-STD-167-1A (Mechanical Vibrations of Shipboard Equipment), MIL-DTL-901E (High-Impact Mechanical Shock for Shipboard Machinery and Equipment), and MIL-STD-461H (Electromagnetic Interference Characteristics of Subsystems and Equipment)? title: Charter Vessel to Conduct a Longline Survey in the Eastern Bering Sea, Aleutian Islands Region, and Gulf of Alaska
description: This is a Sources Sought notice for a Charter Vessel to conduct a Longline Survey in the Eastern Bering Sea, the Aleutian Islands Region, and the Gulf of Alaska. THIS ANNOUNCEMENT IS NOT A SOLICITATION AND IS BEING USED FOR THE PURPOSE OF MARKET RESEARCH ONLY. Solicitations are not available at this time. Requests for a solicitation will not receive a response. This notice does not constitute a commitment by the United States Government. Respondents will not be entitled to payment of direct or indirect costs incurred in responding to this notice. In accordance with Revolutionary Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Overhaul (RFO) 15.101(c), responses to this notice are not quotations and cannot be accepted by the Government to form a binding contract. The attached draft Statement of Work (SOW) is for reference only; the final SOW may change. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA), Acquisition and Grants Office (AGO), Western Acquisition Division (WAD), located in Seattle, WA, is conducting market research to assess the current and near-future marketplace and potential vendors capable of performing a Longline Survey for sablefish and other groundfish in the Eastern Bering Sea, the Aleutian Islands region, and the Gulf of Alaska for the NOAA Fisheries Alaska Fisheries Science Center (AFSC). Information provided in response to this notice will be used to assess tradeoffs and alternatives available to determine how to proceed in the acquisition process. This notice requests interested parties to describe their technical capabilities and demonstrated facilities, processes, and service capabilities. All interested contractors are requested to provide written responses to the questions below. Responding to this notice is necessary to assist NOAA Fisheries in determining the potential levels of interest, adequacy of competition, market maturity, and technical capabilities within the business community to provide the required capabilities. The Government is seeking industry input to determine the feasibility of this charter and the availability of qualified sources with the technical capability to fulfill the requirements outlined in the draft SOW. The Government welcomes industry comments, questions, and suggestions that will aid it in understanding industry capabilities, developing its acquisition strategy, and finalizing the SOW. The purpose of this Sources Sought notice is threefold: To determine the capability, interest, and availability of vendors in the marketplace; For vendors to provide input on compensation structures and cost-recovery arrangements (e.g., daily sea-day and fuel rates offset by catch sales) that ensure contractors are adequately compensated; and To encourage vendor/Government dialog that allows exploration of alternative approaches that may reduce cost and operational risk. If a solicitation is generated by the Government from this notice, the Government reserves the right to use all of the information, use none of the information, or change all or part of the information noted and contained in the attached draft SOW. The Government may utilize the information provided to refine its acquisition strategy to maximize competition among viable alternatives. This notice is being published in accordance with RFO 10.001(b), which requires conducting market research before soliciting quotations for acquisitions with an estimated value in excess of the Simplified Acquisition Threshold. The Government does not intend to disclose vendor proprietary information or trade secrets to the public. However, the Government may use the information submitted by vendors during the market research period in preparing its solicitation and finalizing the SOW, provided this can be done without disclosing proprietary vendor information protected from disclosure pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) and other laws and regulations. Responses to this Sources Sought notice are due to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist. Contact information is as follows: Contracting Officer: Carina Topasna, Carina.Topasna@noaa.gov Contract Specialist: Novelle Key, Novelle.Key@noaa.gov Responses must be submitted via email to the above individuals no later than November 27, 2026 at 2:00 PM Pacific Time. A Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) is requested with your submission. Registration in the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) is not necessary to respond to this notice. If the information in this notice leads to a solicitation, registration in SAM.gov will be a requirement for doing business with and entering into a contract with the Government. All questions regarding this procurement should be sent via email to the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist. If appropriate, an amendment will be posted to provide relevant questions and answers to all interested vendors. This Sources Sought notice is being issued under NAICS: 483114. All interested prospective firms are invited to respond. A determination from this notice may lead to a small business set-aside in accordance with RFO Part 19 if this notice results in a future solicitation. All prospective firms who respond to this notice will be contacted if/when a solicitation is posted to SAM.gov. Cost Recovery and Compensation Mechanism: Under the updated 2027�2031 SOW model, the vessel cleans, processes, and freezes all commercially marketable catch not retained for biological sampling to standards that ensure the highest revenues. Catch is sold by the Contractor within three months of the final day of fishing. Rather than the historical threshold-retention model, the contract utilizes a cost-offset structure: Revenue generated from the sale of retained catch is credited and deducted from the total charter reimbursement cost. The Contractor invoices for Sea Days and fuel following Government review and approval of the mandatory Post-Survey Sales Report. After the first cruise leg, the Contractor provides actual fuel consumption, catch data, and cost-recovery projections; if revenues or agency funding fluctuate, the Government maintains the option to adjust remaining survey days to keep the contract within available funds. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS (CAPABILITIES STATEMENT) Prospective firms should notify the Contracting Officer and Contract Specialist of their interest by submitting a Capabilities Statement that includes their company size, descriptive literature/vessel specifications, and responses to the following items: A statement confirming your firm has the capability to meet the requirements and perform the services outlined in the draft SOW. Your firm's Unique Entity Identifier (UEI). Your firm�s Small Business Administration (SBA) certified status. A brief description of your firm�s recent past experience (within the past three years) performing relevant work. Suggestions or comments regarding the proposed cost-recovery offset model so contractors do not operate at a loss. Suggestions for alternative survey arrangements that increase operational efficiency or decrease operating costs. Specifically, are there modifications to the draft SOW that would increase your firm's interest in submitting a quotation? A Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM) estimate and commentary regarding key cost drivers that should be considered for the attached SOW. All information received in response to this notice shall be treated as Business Sensitive or confidential to the responder, exempt from public release under FOIA.

Offered space must meet Government requirements for fire safety, accessibility, seismic, and sustainability standards per the terms of the Lease. A fully serviced lease is required. Offered space shall not be in the 1-percent-annual chance floodplain (formerly referred to as �100-year� floodplain). Entities are advised to familiarize themselves with the telecommunications prohibitions outlined under Section 889 of the FY19 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), as implemented by the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR). For more information, visit: https://acquisition.gov/FAR-Case-2019-009/889_Part_B. Expressions of interest must Include. 1. Building name and address; 2. Contact information and e-mail address of offeror�s representative; 3. ABOA SF and rentable square feet available, identifying the specific floors and square footages; 4. Submission by anyone other than the owner or manager of a property must be accompanied by written consent from the ownership granting authority to the representative in providing the information to the Government. The U.S. Government currently occupies office and related space in a building under a lease in Holtsville, NY, that will be expiring. The Government is considering alternative space if economically advantageous. In making this determination, the Government will consider, among other things, the availability of alternative space that potentially can satisfy the Government�s requirements, as well as costs likely to be incurred through relocating, such as physical move costs, replication of tenant improvements and telecommunication infrastructure, and non-productive agency downtime. The proposed action is for the acquisition of Light Interference Filter (LIF), NSN: 5855-01-379-1410. The Government owns the Technical Data Package (TDP), which is the Light Interference Filter Performance Specification, for this item. The solicitation will include instructions to request these documents. Due to the sensitive nature of this item, potential sources will have to request and receive authorization prior to the release of this information. Night Vision Devices and components, and their associated technical data, are restricted from export by the International Trafficking in Arms Regulation (ITAR), Part 121, Category XII. The TDP is subject to the Internal Traffic in Arms Regulations. Any Offeror who wants to request a copy of the TDP must be registered in the Joint Certification Program, website is below: https://public.logisticsinformationservice.dla.mil/PublicHome/jcp/default.aspx Requests for a copy of the TDP after the RFP is issued must include proof of DD Form 2345 JCP Certification and proof of Facility Security Clearance (FCL) / Level of Safeguarding for Classified Information / Material of SECRET / SECRET. The documents to retrieve the TDP are attached to this solicitation. First Article Testing (FAT) will be required, which will be detailed in the solicitation. An Offeror may request a FAT waiver if certain conditions are met. A DD Form 254 Contract Security Classification Specification is part of this requirement and will be included in the RFP. To be eligible for award, an Offeror will be required to have access to classified data. The required Facility Security Clearance (FCL) / Level of Safeguarding for Classified Information / Material is SECRET / SECRET. The anticipated hardware ship to location will be W25G1U, New Cumberland, PA. The Government required delivery will be listed in the solicitation. title: Denmark – Tents – Genudbud af Rammeaftale vedrørende teltservice
description: Udbuddet omfatter en rammeaftale om leje af teltservice til brug for arrangementer, øvelser og events, som afvikles af Ordregiver (”Rammeaftalen”). Rammeaftalen har til formål at dække ETKs løbende behov for leje af telte og tilhørende faciliteter til Forsvarsministeriets og underliggende myndigheders etablissementer. Rammeaftalen omfatter levering af den udbudte ydelse til Ordregivers lokationer i hele Danmark, inkl. ikke-brofaste øer. Der forventes dog alene et mindre behov for levering af ydelser til ikke-brofaste øer. Rammeaftalen indgås for en 4-årig periode, og den anslåede årlige værdi udgør 35.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms – det vil sige samlet 140.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi udgør 280.000.000 kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalen omfatter leje af Teltservice inklusive følgende ydelser: • Telte til events og sanitære faciliteter • Telte til indkvartering og sanitære faciliteter • Materiale (enkeltvarer), herunder (ikke udtømmende): o Kontor- og beboelsesvogne o Køle- og frysecontainere til opbevaring af mad o Teknisk udstyr (hegn, lys, varme/køl, strøm, kabler, mv.) Rammeaftalen indgås med to leverandører. Opgaver, der tildeles på grundlag af Rammeaftalen, tildeles direkte på de vilkår, der er fastsat i Rammeaftalen, herunder de aftalte priser og øvrige kontraktvilkår. Som udgangspunkt tildeles alle opgaver til 1. prioritetsleverandøren. 2. prioritetsleverandøren tildeles alene en opgave i de i Rammeaftalens pkt. 8 angivne situationer.

description: El objeto del presente contrato es la concesión del servicio de explotación del Hotel Oromana, de titularidad municipal, situado en el municipio de Alcalá de Guadaíra, que comprende la gestión integral del establecimiento, así como la ejecución de las actuaciones necesarias de rehabilitación, reforma, posible ampliación y adecuación del inmueble para su correcto funcionamiento y mejora de categoría, todo ello conforme a lo establecido en el correspondiente pliego de prescripciones técnicas. La presente contratación tiene como finalidad la transformación integral del establecimiento hotelero, con el objetivo de su adecuación a los estándares actuales del sector y su posicionamiento como hotel de cuatro estrellas, mediante la ejecución de las actuaciones constructivas necesarias y la implantación de un modelo de gestión profesionalizado, eficiente y orientado a la calidad. No se pretende con esta licitación una mera explotación del establecimiento en su estado actual, sino la definición y desarrollo de un proyecto global y coherente que integre la intervención sobre el inmueble con un modelo de gestión hotelera alineado con el valor patrimonial, paisajístico y turístico del entorno en el que se inserta, contribuyendo a reforzar la identidad y singularidad del destino. En este sentido, la concesión deberá orientarse a la creación de una oferta hotelera de calidad, capaz de atraer tanto a visitantes como a usuarios locales, generando actividad económica, empleo y sinergias con otros sectores vinculados al turismo, la cultura y la hostelería, y actuando como elemento dinamizador del municipio y su entorno. Asimismo, el contrato comprende tanto la ejecución de las obras definidas como obligatorias, como, en su caso, la incorporación de mejoras propuestas por los licitadores, así como la gestión integral del establecimiento, incluyendo todos los servicios necesarios para su correcto funcionamiento. El detalle y alcance de todas estas prestaciones se desarrollan en el pliego de prescripciones técnicas que rige la presente contratación.
